name: Friend of the Void
source:
Visit the darkness your lost friend succumbed to in hopes of getting them back; questioning and befriending eldritch beings that inhabit this world in order to do so!

[From [url=https://sleepless-seven.itch.io/friend-of-the-void]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
探访你失去的朋友屈服于的黑暗，希望把他们找回来；为了做到这一点，询问居住在这个世界上的可怕生物并与之成为朋友！

[来自[url=https://sleepless-seven.itch.io/friend-of-the-void]Itch.io[/url]]
